summary: When wholesale electricity prices drop below zero during periods of excess renewable generation, as they did over the recent holiday weekend in Europe, flexibility becomes a revenue source.

title: Swiss balancing energy market now open to C&I solar
summary: With the “AMAG Energy Flexpool,” existing photovoltaic systems in commercial, industrial, and multi-family buildings can now participate in the Swiss balancing energy market without additional hardware and via fully remote integration. Self-consumption, however, remains fully possible.

title: Oman seeks consultant for green hydrogen project
summary: Oman’s Nama Power and Water Procurement (PWP) is looking for a consultancy to carry out an initial assessment of a proposed hydrogen-based independent power project with a capacity of up to 1 GW. The deadline to submit proposals is June 21.

title: Rooftop solar surges to new high in Australia on back of battery boom
summary: Australia’s rooftop solar market climbed by 31% in the past month with the latest data revealing that a record 442 MW of small-scale PV capacity was installed across the country in April 2026.

title: New technique measures water ingress in PV modules without disconnecting them
summary: A German research team has developed a nondestructive, on-site method to quantify water ingress in photovoltaic modules using near-infrared absorption (NIRA) spectroscopy calibrated with Karl–Fischer titration (KFT). The approach enables precise measurement of absolute moisture content in sealed modules without disassembly, improving inspection, failure analysis, and lifetime prediction.

title: Western Australia backs grid buildout ahead of coal exit
summary: Western Australia plans to establish a clean energy fund to support transmission and network projects, as state-owned coal-fired power plants approach retirement, according to the state government.

title: Pumped storage project advances at 1.35 GW hydropower plant in India
summary: GE Vernova has secured an order from Megha Engineering & Infrastructures Ltd (MEIL) to deliver nine 150 MW pumped-storage units for the 1.35 GW Upper Sileru hydropower plant in India.

title: Fluorine use in PV backsheets dropped sharply over past three decades
summary: Researchers in Austria found that fluorine and fluoropolymer content in PV backsheets has significantly decreased over the past three decades, driven by a shift from fluorine-rich multilayer structures to fluorine-free or coated alternatives. Despite this decline, fluoropolymer-containing backsheets remain important for end-of-life management due to environmental persistence concerns.

title: Enphase moves into AI data center power with solid-state transformer
summary: Enphase Energy has detailed the architecture of its IQ Solid-State Transformer (IQ SST), a distributed power conversion system designed to supply regulated 800 VDC power to AI data center infrastructure.

title: EU funding ban on high-risk inverters, including Chinese suppliers, extends to BESS
summary: The new policy has already applied, and impacts billions in funding from the European Investment Bank on renewable projects including standalone and co-located storage.

title: IFC, Norfund back 315 solar hybrid minigrids in Nigeria
summary: The solar minigrids, to be developed by five renewable energy service companies, are expected to facilitate over 494,000 new electricity connections in Nigeria.

title: Heat pump sales rise 17% across Europe in Q1 as energy prices surge
summary: Residential heat pump sales increased 17% across 11 European countries in the first quarter of 2026, following a sharp rise in gas and oil prices after Iran closed the Strait of Hormuz in March, says the European Heat Pump Association (EHPA).

title: Solar on canals reduces water evaporation by 70% and algae growth by 85%
summary: The 1.6 MW Nexus pilot project in California has demonstrated that solar panels installed over irrigation canals can significantly reduce water evaporation and algae growth by 85%, while also showing operational efficiency.

title: Madagascar plans 46 solar projects totaling 932 MW
summary: Madagascar’s state-owned utility Jirama and the country’s rural electrification development agency have signed 46 memoranda of understanding for new solar projects with a combined capacity totalling 932 MW.

title: China Datang brings online 500 MW solar farm for direct data center supply
summary: The project is integrated into a larger 2 GW first-phase build-out combining solar, wind, and storage, and uses dedicated transmission lines plus market trading to match renewable supply with data center demand.

title: Japan reopens NEDO perovskite solar call with single-junction focus
summary: Japan’s New Energy and Industrial Technology Development Organization (NEDO) has opened a supplementary call for proposals on mass production of next-generation single-junction perovskite solar cells, with submissions due by June 3.

title: Study finds ‘relatively good’ agreement in worldwide solar cell calibrations, but flags key differences in testing methods
summary: An interlaboratory comparison across nine metrology institutes found generally good agreement in solar cell calibration under the World Photovoltaic Scale, but still revealed measurable differences in short-circuit current, voltage, and power due to varying methods and conditions.

title: SRP and NextEra to develop 3 GW of new solar by 2034
summary: Salt River Project has an agreement with NextEra Energy Resources to develop 3,000 megawatts of solar generation in Arizona by 2034.

title: Intelligence is cheaper than infrastructure: The case for demand-side flexibility
summary: A new report from Schneider Electric highlights demand-side flexibility in buildings as a key resource for grid relief, and a case study from a partnership with AMS touts tangible community benefits.

title: Michigan House panel takes testimony on dam safety reforms as heavy rain strains structures across state
summary: Michigan House Natural Resources and Tourism Committee reviewed dam safety regulations, prompted by the 2020 Sanford and Edenville dam failures.

title: GE Vernova lands equipment order for one of India’s largest pumped storage projects
summary: GE Vernova secured an order from Megha Engineering & Infrastructures Limited for nine 150 MW units at the Upper Sileru hydropower plant in Andhra Pradesh, India, to be completed by 2030.

title: DOE to release $430M for American hydropower fleet
summary: The Department of Energy's Hydropower and Hydrokinetic Office will resume negotiations for nearly $430 million in payments to 212 hydropower facilities.

title: Clarion Events North America names new EVP of Energy
summary: Wayne Bishop Jr. has joined Clarion Events North America as Executive Vice President of Energy, overseeing POWERGEN, DTECH, and Factor This.

title: It’s getting expensive to gas up | Factor This Brief
summary: It's getting awfully expensive to fill your tank in the United States. Meanwhile, solar energy runs rampant; The Orange County Convention Center doubles its rooftop generation, SunPower clears debt, Energea starts construction in Texas, and Georgia Power helps Kia with a solar canopy.

title: Non-compliance with a looming NERC deadline could cost clean energy owners and operators, big time
summary: Owners of inverter-based resources (IBRs) have been required to register with NERC by May 15, 2026, or face steep penalties.

title: How VPPs could improve grid reliability and save utilities 40% over gas peaker plants
summary: A new report outlines how virtual power plants can free up capacity on the existing grid while highlighting how VPPs can also help meet new load growth driven by data centers.

title: Are Trump’s efforts against clean energy in vain? – This Week in Cleantech
summary: On this episode of the This Week in Cleantech podcast, Oliver Milman from The Guardian discusses how the clean energy industry is pushing forward despite Trump's aggressive efforts to suppress it.
